errors.says: Method: 'stage j adds the bank X into Y along coordinate j (forward invocation), then subtracts Y from X, then adds X to Y again', which reads as if each stage performs all three updates.
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation X->Y, stage 2 the inverse schedule Y->X (X<-X-Y), stage 3 a forward invocation X->Y; one operation per stage, each on a different coordinate (731-733, 761-763). S1.1.2 states this correctly.

errors.says: Each prefix-slot round 'halves a bit individually by buffering a pair of records, in O(Tp) per round', with a total of O(TpdK).
errors.paper: Participating bits in a prefix round are processed individually at O(Tp) each, so a round costs O(TpD); with at most b+1<=K rounds the total is O(TpdK) (3106-3128). 'O(Tp) per round' does not give the stated total.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: fixed networks, frames, labels and rank saving (S1.1-S1.4) feed the interchange recurrence (S1.5) and the butterfly-layer recurrence (S1.6); these drive the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S2), the resampling and chirp cancellation (S3), parameters (S4), the algorithm and exact recovery (S5) and the cost table (S6), reaching O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) and the conjecture's negation (S7). Nothing essential is missing. The only thin spot is that the elementary stream and controlled-shift lemmas are used as tools without being stated.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3 with v=C(100,3), m=h^3, and the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the motivation that each edge then costs only a frame change are explicit.

Nondegenerate subspace labels in the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}, comparability on every edge, and decreasing edges only on central wires 3->4 each losing h are stated with the label and residual tables.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N source-edge exceptions 2P_{U_a} of rank one are stated with the reason.
Signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=(Wm-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b are all given.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, giving deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 and hence s<Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and zero-to-identity on other roles, so the frames give Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, one interchange per one of Pi plus O(V), so each edge needs rank(A_e) recursive calls and a node makes exactly s calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau) are all present.

central.summary: All nine central steps are reconstructed with their defining quantities: the fixed h=100 bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the only loss on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539 (101/539) giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, rank-a shears costing a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The plan carries the chain in the paper's order and role.
